title: Enforce grants mechanically instead of by prompt alone
narrative: Soft guidance may ask models to be careful; hard grants still refuse unauthorized writes. Accepts inspiration requirement 9[^insp-r09]. Complements `fangore_insp_risk_autonomy`. Soft-vs-hard split for self-revising MH-SR-03[^insp-sr-03-hard].
implementation:
Harness tool loops consult `AccessControl` before execution — including fused or loop-proposed calls — and denied calls emit access-check events and never run side effects. Failure defaults are deny for mutations / external / privileged / uncertain scope; composed packs from `fangore_compound_grants` still apply. Prompts never grant permission.

Covers: GAT-01, GAT-02, GAT-03.
validation: Harness `cli` `probe` loads `plans/tool_gating.yaml` (human-readable probe plan); hard expects on declared observation keys.

footnotes.label: Self-revising recipe map (MH-SR-03 soft vs hard)
